notes: flip_begin holds shape_transition_mu_ while reserving the shared listener state before publishing Planning.
IoDrain ACK requires terminal accept and cancel completions before the frozen Client plan is built.
Listener destinations register kernel references before IoPrepare ACK; newly listening sockets already have a registered rollback owner.
Original quota checks run before the admission epoch; retained Client creation does not contaminate the frozen plan.
The cancellation epoch is separate from the reused borrowed-listener retry flag; the forced overlap fails the previous candidate and passes POST.
UNIX owner remains pinned. TLS identity is checked when resulting owners rearm; existing TLS client migration restrictions remain intact.
IoLoop objects live in the main-thread ios vector and are destroyed after workers join; shutdown descriptor metadata is not concurrently destroyed.
GET/SET/MGET/MSET body identity and all existing layout offsets are preserved; exceptional retries and transferred-listener dispatch are outside the ordinary-path cost proof.
